result:
The proposed answer rests on a wrong computation, so I reject it.

The solution claims that from a vertex of a regular 2025-gon, the other 2024 vertices span an angle of 180 − 180/2025 degrees. This is incorrect. The vertex angle of a regular n-gon is 180(n−2)/n, so for n = 2025 it is 180 − 360/2025 = 180 − 8/45. This is the angle that contains all the other vertices. The solution's value of 180 − 180/2025 is therefore wrong.

The solution also gives no argument for sufficiency (that every α in the claimed range works for every placement). It simply asserts that this is so.

The value 4/45 that appears in the final answer comes from the wrong spread. Using the correct vertex angle for the regular polygon, the value of inf S + sup S would be 360 − 8/45, not 360 − 4/45. This does not match 16196/45.

VERDICT: REJECT
